_about: Cross-check reference only: USD per million tokens, per model, read off omp's own per-turn usage.cost components divided by their token counts (the modal figure across ~/.omp/agent/sessions on 2026-10-03; cache_write split by usage.cttl). member-outcomes.tsv's `cost` is the $ of record; pr-cost.mjs uses this table only to report how far that recorded `cost` sits from the token columns priced here, never to produce a $. null = no turn of that kind was recorded for the model.
